ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, the graphs of the linear functions $y=kx$ and $y=mx+n$ are shown as in the figure. What is the solution set of the linear inequality $kx>mx+n$ in terms of $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it's known that the intersection point of the two functions is $(1,2)$,\\
thus the solution set of the linear inequality in $x$, $kx - n > mx$, is $x > 1$,\\
therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x > 1}$.
